subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up preserve the current Android settings, node approval, and `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` gates while investigating advertising/A2UI readiness, or intentionally change the camera/location command exposure contract?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and source inspection shows both real implementations and multiple security/approval gates; automation should not choose whether to broaden exposure from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run live Android proof first, keep `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` behind explicit gateway opt-in, and repair only reproduced advertising, approval, settings, docs, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Change command exposure policy
options.body: Broaden Android camera or location exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after proof
options.body: If live proof shows independent causes, track camera, location, and A2UI as separate owner-reviewed repairs.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run live Android proof first, keep `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` behind explicit gateway opt-in, and repair only reproduced advertising, approval, settings, docs, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README names this handle as the Android app contact, and the decision centers on Android app behavior and sensitive node capability exposure.
